text: Herbalife, the LA Galaxy front sponsor, is listed on the NYSE (HLF) with a public float and no state stake. It is rated 'concern' on conduct, not ownership: in July 2016 Herbalife settled FTC charges for $200m and was forced to restructure distributor rewards after the FTC found misleading earnings claims in its multi-level marketing model - the distributor network being the human-rights/consumer-pressure point. Otherwise unremarkable.
short: Herbalife, the LA Galaxy front sponsor, is listed on the NYSE (HLF) with a public float and no state stake.

source.name: US Federal Trade Commission press release - Herbalife $200m settlement
source.quote: Herbalife International of America, Inc., Herbalife International, Inc., and Herbalife, Ltd. have agreed to fully restructure their U.S. business operations and pay $200 million

additionalSources.name: Herbalife Ltd. SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1 (company press release filed with SEC)
additionalSources.quote: Herbalife also agreed to make a $200 million payment to the FTC as part of the settlement.
